results.title: Supporters gather at Ramlila Maidan for INDIA bloc’s protest rally against CEC Gyanesh Kumar
results.content: Supporters have started to gather at Delhi’s Ramlila Maidan for the INDIA bloc’s November 1 ‘Vote Bachao, Desh Bachao’ rally, demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar’s resignation. The INDIA bloc is protesting the Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision (SIR) of voter lists, alleging irregularities and the risk of eligible voters being excluded. The Opposition has accused the poll body of failing to ensure electoral transparency and is demanding accountability from the CEC.
